name: Zhongmin Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongmin Energy Co., Ltd. develops, constructs, and operates new energy power generation projects in China. It is involved in the investment, development, construction, and operation of new energy power generation projects, such as wind power and photovoltaic power, as well as solar power. The company was formerly known as Nanzhi Co Ltd. and changed its name to Zhongmin Energy Co., Ltd. in December 2015. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Fuzhou, China. Zhongmin Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Fujian Investment & Development Group Co.,Ltd.
